title: Event Management Company for Sale in Chennai, India
tagline: Chennai-based experiential technology company with over 14 years of industry experience, serving government, entertainment, and real estate clients. - Specialises in 3D projection mapping, laser and sound-and-light shows, water-screen projections, holographic installations, and immersive experience centres. - Executed 3D projection mapping on the Telangana State Secretariat facade for the Telangana Rising Global Summit. - Delivered projection and laser shows for Amazon Prime launches, including Shershaah in Kargil and Durgawathi. - Supplied laser systems for sound-and-light shows at the Gateway of India, Golconda Fort, and Leh Palace. - Executed projects at Chetpet Lake, Ved Van Park in Noida, and the Vivekananda Memorial House in Rameswaram. - Developed three immersive experience centres for the Puravankara Group. - Serves as the Indian distributor for a Germany-based laser technology group, covering equipment distribution, sales, and project implementation. - Partners with a real estate technology company to provide digital twins and holographic solutions for the real estate sector. - Offers project-based design and installation services, equipment distribution, rentals, event activations, annual maintenance contracts, and after-sales support. - Maintains an active project pipeline involving opportunities such as the Mysore Palace show tender, Brigade WTC Bengaluru, and Chennai Metro. - Operates specialised business divisions focused on architectural projection mapping, multimedia water-screen shows, sky projections, and life-size floor plan walkthroughs for real estate developers. - The founder has led the business since 2011 and has expertise in lighting design for museums, building facades, and live events. - Employs four staff members and engages an additional 2–3 freelancers to support project execution. - Member of the Event & Entertainment Management Association (EEMA) and recipient of an EEMA award. - Holds a business registration certificate and certifications in Syncronorm Depence fountain design and Dataton WATCHOUT Advanced, supporting the design and execution of multimedia shows, projection mapping, and immersive installations. - The founder has technical proficiency in Unreal Engine, MadMapper, Vectorworks, and 3ds Max for 3D visualisation, show design, and previsualisation.
